All 10 endpoints (health + 9 /v1/* routes). Bearer auth is set at collection level via {{readToken}} — every request inherits it except /health and the two explicit "No Auth"/"Bad Token" negative tests, which override it.

KNOWN BUG, deliberately left demonstrated rather than worked around: the "Equity Detail - BKG (known bug)" request asserts CORRECT behavior (dividend.confidence should be "confirmed", since BKG has a real, sourced FY2025 dividend). It will currently FAIL — both /watchlist and /equities pick the Fundamental row with the latest periodEnd, and BKG's latest period (H1 2026) has no dividend while an earlier period (FY2025) does. Run that request to see it demonstrated, not just described.

Capture requests (POST /v1/capture/*) hit live TradingView — run those deliberately, not as part of an unattended full-collection run on a tight loop.

item.name: Admin (writes — requires ADMIN_TOKEN, separate from READ_TOKEN)
item.description:
All requests in this folder override the collection-level bearer auth to use {{adminToken}} instead of {{readToken}} — set both in your environment. Every business rule here (reportUrl required for real figures, ticker must exist, sourceTier/enum allowlists) is enforced by packages/db/src/admin.ts, shared with the CLI seed scripts — not reimplemented in the HTTP layer.

Create/Delete pairs are self-cleaning: the create test uses a deliberately fake ticker/period/actionId (SCOM + periodEnd 2099-12-31, or an actionId ending in DELETE-ME) that can't collide with real data, and the delete test immediately after removes it. Safe to run the whole folder repeatedly.
